# query commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explain` | Show the execution plan for a SQL query |
| `fetch` | Execute a FetchXML query against Dataverse |
| `history` | Manage SQL query history: list, get, execute, delete, clear |
| `sql` | Execute a SQL query against Dataverse (transpiled to FetchXML) |
